easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
The permanent that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing Down in the Valley to trigger.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

uses.name: Down in the Valley
uses.cardState: with two or more lore counters on it
